# Quality Excellence

Build quality into systems rather than inspecting for it afterwards.

---

## Principles

- [Build Quality In](../principles/build-quality-in.md) — prevention over detection
- Test at the appropriate level — most tests should be fast and isolated
- Automate validation — anything repeatedly validated manually should be automated
- Quality is a team responsibility — not owned by QA alone

---

## Testing Strategy

→ [Testing Pyramid](../testing/testing-pyramid.md)

The three levels:
- [Unit Tests](../testing/unit-tests.md) — fast, isolated, business logic focused
- [Integration Tests](../testing/integration-tests.md) — service and data interactions
- [End-to-End Tests](../testing/end-to-end-tests.md) — critical user journeys, used selectively

---

## Quality Gates

Every PR should pass:
- Automated tests
- Code quality checks
- Security scans
- Peer review approval

Branch protection should enforce:
- No direct commits to main
- Required approvals
- Required status checks

---

## Strong Signals

- Automated validation at every stage
- Fast feedback loops
- Low defect escape rate
- Stable, predictable releases

## Weak Signals

- Frequent regressions
- Manual testing as primary quality control
- Customer-reported defects
- Unpredictable releases
